32:2: The revelation of the Book, there is no doubt in it, is from the Rabb of the worlds.
32:3: Or do they say, 'He fabricated it'? No, it is the truth from your Rabb so that you may warn a people to whom no warner has come before you.
32:4: Allah is the One Who created the heavens and the earth and what is between the two in six days, then ruled over the Arsh. You have neither a protector nor an intercessor besides Him. Will you still not take heed?
32:5: He directs the affair from the heaven to the earth, then that affair ascends to Him in a day equivalent to a thousand years of what you count.
32:6: That is the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed; He is al-Aziz, al-Rahim.
32:7: The One Who made good everything He created and began the creation of man from clay.
32:8: Then He made his offspring from an extract of a base water.
32:9: Then He fashioned him and breathed into him from His spirit, and made for you hearing, sights, and hearts.
32:10: And they said: 'When we are lost in the earth, shall we really be in a new creation?' No, they are deniers of the meeting with their Rabb.
32:11: Say: 'The angel of death, who has been put in charge of you, will take your souls; then to your Rabb you will be returned.'
32:12: If only you could see then the criminals with their heads bowed before their Rabb, saying: 'Our Rabb, we have seen and we have heard, so now send us back that we may do righteous deeds, for we are now firmly convinced.'
32:13: If We had willed, We would surely have given every soul its guidance. But the word from Me has come true: 'I will surely fill Hell completely with jinn and humans.'
32:14: So taste the consequence of your having forgotten the meeting of this day of yours; surely We have forgotten you, and taste the eternal punishment for what you used to do.
32:15: Only those believe in Our verses who, when they are reminded with them, fall down prostrating and glorify their Rabb with praise, and they are not arrogant.
32:16: Their sides forsake their beds; they pray to their Rabb in fear and hope, and they spend from what We have provided for them.
32:17: No soul knows what comfort of the eyes has been hidden for them as a reward for what they used to do.
32:18: Is the one who is a believer like the one who is defiantly disobedient? They are not equal.
32:19: As for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for them are the gardens of Paradise as hospitality for what they used to do.
32:20: As for those who strayed, their refuge is the Fire. Every time they wish to come out of it, they are returned into it, and it is said to them: 'Taste the punishment of the Fire which you used to deny.'
32:21: And We will surely make them taste of the nearer punishment before the greater punishment, so that perhaps they may return.
32:22: And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Rabb, then turns away from them? Surely We take retribution from the criminals.
32:23: And We certainly gave Moses the Book, so do not be in doubt about meeting him, and We made it a guidance for the Children of Israel.
32:24: And We made from among them leaders guiding by Our command when they were patient and had certainty in Our verses.
32:25: Surely your Rabb will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
32:26: Has it not guided them, how many generations We destroyed before them in whose dwellings they walk? Surely in that are signs; will they still not listen?
32:27: Have they not seen that We drive the water to the barren land and bring forth thereby crops from which their cattle and they themselves eat? Will they still not see?
32:28: And they say: "When will this victory be, if you are truthful?"
32:29: Say: "On the Day of Judgment, their faith will not benefit those who disbelieve, nor will they be reprieved."
32:30: So turn away from them and wait; surely they are waiting.
